## `src/metal/capture.rs`

On-demand MLX-C Metal GPU capture control.

C declarations: `mlx-c/mlx/c/metal.h::{mlx_metal_start_capture, mlx_metal_stop_capture}`. The bindgen allowlist does not include these two symbols, so they are declared here directly against the already-linked `mlxc`/`mlx` native libraries.

Capture is opt-in and inert by default. Metal only records when the target process was started with `MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1`; without that layer, `mlx_metal_start_capture` fails and the caller logs and continues, so enabling the env var can never change a serving request's result.

### `MlxBindingsContext::start_metal_capture`

```rust
pub fn start_metal_capture(&self, capture_path: &str) -> Result<(), MlxCError>
```

Starts a Metal GPU capture writing an Xcode `.gputrace` bundle at `capture_path`.

### `MlxBindingsContext::stop_metal_capture`

```rust
pub fn stop_metal_capture(&self) -> Result<(), MlxCError>
```

Stops the active Metal GPU capture, finalizing the `.gputrace` bundle.

## `src/metal/cuda_kernel.rs`

The MLX-C CUDA fast-kernel family.

The CUDA backend's symbols exist in the linked native image but the backend reports itself unavailable on Apple Silicon; the wrappers keep the surface callable and typed so builds that target CUDA-capable hosts need no bridge work.

### `MlxMetalKernel`

```rust
pub struct MlxMetalKernel
```

Owned MLX custom Metal kernel function compiled from a source string.

### `MlxMetalKernel::new`

```rust
pub fn new(kernel_name: &str, input_names: &[&str], output_names: &[&str], kernel_source: &str) -> Result<Self, MlxCError>
```

Declares a kernel from its name, argument names, and Metal source body, which MLX wraps in a generated function signature.

**Errors:** Fails when no inputs or outputs are named, or a string holds a null byte.

### `MlxMetalKernel::new_with_header`

```rust
pub fn new_with_header(kernel_name: &str, input_names: &[&str], output_names: &[&str], kernel_header: &str, kernel_source: &str) -> Result<Self, MlxCError>
```

Like `new`, with source placed before the generated function, for helper functions and includes.

**Errors:** Fails when no inputs or outputs are named, or a string holds a null byte.

### `MlxMetalKernel::new_with_options`

```rust
pub fn new_with_options(kernel_name: &str, input_names: &[&str], output_names: &[&str], kernel_header: &str, kernel_source: &str, has_atomic_outputs: bool) -> Result<Self, MlxCError>
```

Like `new_with_header`, also choosing whether outputs are declared as `atomic`, which a kernel needs to write them from many threads safely.

**Errors:** Fails when no inputs or outputs are named, or a string holds a null byte.

### `MlxBindingsContext::apply_metal_kernel`

```rust
pub fn apply_metal_kernel(&self, kernel: &MlxMetalKernel, input_arrays: &[&MlxArray], output_specs: &[MlxMetalKernelOutput], grid: [i32; 3], thread_group: [i32; 3], template_arguments: &[MlxMetalKernelTemplateArgument]) -> Result<Vec<MlxArray>, MlxCError>
```

Applies one owned custom Metal kernel on this context's stream.

### `MlxBindingsContext::apply_metal_kernel_with_output_initialization`

```rust
pub fn apply_metal_kernel_with_output_initialization(&self, kernel: &MlxMetalKernel, input_arrays: &[&MlxArray], output_specs: &[MlxMetalKernelOutput], grid: [i32; 3], thread_group: [i32; 3], template_arguments: &[MlxMetalKernelTemplateArgument], output_initial_value: Option<f32>) -> Result<Vec<MlxArray>, MlxCError>
```

Like `apply_metal_kernel`, also filling outputs with `output_initial_value` so a kernel can leave elements unwritten.

**Errors:** Fails when the launch dimensions or argument counts are invalid. A shader that does not compile fails later, when the output is evaluated.

### `MlxBindingsContext::apply_metal_kernel_with_config`

```rust
pub fn apply_metal_kernel_with_config(&self, kernel: &MlxMetalKernel, input_arrays: &[&MlxArray], kernel_config: &MlxMetalKernelConfig) -> Result<Vec<MlxArray>, MlxCError>
```

Applies a kernel with a caller-built `MlxMetalKernelConfig`.

MLX's kernel call takes `verbose` on the call, and MLX-C stores that flag on the config passed to `mlx_fast_metal_kernel_apply`. The convenience methods build a config with verbose left off, which is MLX's default, so `MlxMetalKernelConfig::set_verbose` only affects a launch that receives this config.

**Errors:** Fails when the launch has no inputs, or MLX rejects the launch. A shader that does not compile fails later, when the output is evaluated.

### `apply_metal_kernel_in_graph`

```rust
pub fn apply_metal_kernel_in_graph(kernel: &MlxMetalKernel, input_arrays: &[&MlxArray], output_specs: &[MlxMetalKernelOutput], grid: [i32; 3], thread_group: [i32; 3], template_arguments: &[MlxMetalKernelTemplateArgument], gpu_stream: &MlxStream) -> Result<Vec<MlxArray>, i32>
```

Applies one custom Metal kernel inside a compiled-graph trace.

Identical to `MlxBindingsContext::apply_metal_kernel` minus the runtime handle: compiled-graph builders run without a runtime, on the stream the trace is being built for. Errors surface as plain status codes. Launch dimensions are rejected by `MlxMetalKernelConfig::new` unless every component is positive.

### `apply_metal_kernel_in_graph_with_config`

```rust
pub fn apply_metal_kernel_in_graph_with_config(kernel: &MlxMetalKernel, input_arrays: &[&MlxArray], kernel_config: &MlxMetalKernelConfig, gpu_stream: &MlxStream) -> Result<Vec<MlxArray>, i32>
```

Like `apply_metal_kernel_in_graph`, with a caller-built config so `MlxMetalKernelConfig::set_verbose` reaches the trace.

**Errors:** Returns `1` when the launch has no inputs or a handle cannot be built, and MLX's own status when the apply call itself fails.

### `MlxMetalKernelConfig`

```rust
pub struct MlxMetalKernelConfig
```

One launch's configuration for a custom Metal kernel: its outputs, grid, thread group, template arguments, and whether MLX prints the generated shader.

### `MlxMetalKernelConfig::new`

```rust
pub fn new(output_specs: &[MlxMetalKernelOutput], grid: [i32; 3], thread_group: [i32; 3], output_initial_value: Option<f32>) -> Result<Self, MlxCError>
```

Builds a launch configuration from output declarations, grid, thread group, and an optional output fill value.

**Errors:** Fails when a grid or thread-group dimension is not positive, or when MLX rejects a configuration value.

### `MlxMetalKernelConfig::add_template_arguments`

```rust
pub fn add_template_arguments(&mut self, template_arguments: &[MlxMetalKernelTemplateArgument]) -> Result<(), MlxCError>
```

Adds compile-time template arguments to this launch.

The signature takes `&mut self` because the call writes into the config MLX already allocated. A shared reference would hide that write.

**Errors:** Fails when a name contains an interior null byte, or MLX rejects a value.

### `MlxMetalKernelConfig::set_verbose`

```rust
pub fn set_verbose(&mut self, verbose: bool) -> Result<(), MlxCError>
```

Asks MLX to print the generated shader when this config is applied.

This is the `verbose` argument of MLX's kernel call. It has no effect until the config is passed to `MlxBindingsContext::apply_metal_kernel_with_config` or `apply_metal_kernel_in_graph_with_config`. The convenience launch methods leave it off, which is MLX's default.

## `src/metal/metallib.rs`

Safe wrapper over the MLX AOT metallib path override.

### `set_metallib_path`

```rust
pub fn set_metallib_path(path: &CStr) -> Result<(), MlxCError>
```

Overrides the metallib MLX loads.

The policy owner resolves and verifies WHICH metallib to load; this wrapper only performs the official override call.
